h1: Amazon listing creation, written to Amazon's rules
overview: We create new product listings in your Seller Central account, from the product data you send. Each gets a title within Amazon's style limits, five clear bullet points, a description, backend search terms and the right category attributes, plus variation families where products belong together. We check each against Amazon's rules on claims and prohibited words before saving, and we match to existing catalog pages when your product already has one.

faq: What do you need to start?
Product details like what it is, size, material, use, certifications you hold, GTIN or exemption and photos. If something is missing we ask, because wrong data causes suppressed listings.
Do you handle barcodes and GTINs?
We enter the GTINs you own, and apply for a GTIN exemption in Seller Central where you qualify. We never buy or invent barcodes, since Amazon may remove listings with invalid ones.
What claims can the listing make?
Only true ones you can support. We avoid words Amazon prohibits, such as medical or health claims and phrases like best seller, and we keep price and shipping out of the title.
